messages:
sylvia_sales: FYI — Meridian Bank sent an RFI. Required: EU-only processing during POC, SOC2 Type II excerpt, proof of sustained 500 embeddings/sec, ops acceptance matrix, deletion certificate after POC, and a short POC SOW. They also asked about a short-term reserved pilot price that converts to a 12-month commitment.

neil_se: Clarify: 500 embeddings/sec = aggregate across endpoints? any p95 latency target?

sylvia_sales: They said 'sustained 500/sec aggregate' and prefer p95 <275ms.

neil_se: Quick capacity note: Hosted EU control plane typically sustains ~320-360/s p95~260ms on rwd-embed-v1. Dedicated (4xA100 equiv) with 4-bit quant + KV cache reuse can hit 700+/s. Recommend Dedicated/Private for guaranteed residency and deletion certs.

tara_security: I'll prepare a redacted SOC2 bundle under NDA. Hosted: we offer customer-managed keys in our EU control plane (no HSM guarantee). Private supports BYOK/HSM. Will draft language for deletion certificate requiring tenant ID and signed request.

ben_sre: Proposed POC gates: 1) sustained 500 embeddings/sec for 30m 2) p95 <275ms over that window 3) KV cache hit-rate >60% 4) cold-start recovery <60s 5) canary rollback test (10% traffic rollback) 6) SIEM log forwarding enabled. Add model pinning & rollback validation.

sylvia_sales: Add 'signed deletion certificate within 5 business days of request' to the gates. Also include conversion discount language: up to 20% if they convert to 12-month reserved pool (TBD by sizing).

neil_se: I'll draft a short technical appendix + curl harness for reproducible benchmarks and include Dedicated lab numbers. Snippet for RFI: 

```
for i in $(seq 1 600); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFW_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v1","input":"test payload"}' &
done
wait
```

ben_sre: I'll update the capability matrix with a 'POC acceptance' column and 'EU residency' flag.

upload-bot: Uploaded 'capability_matrix_meridian_v2.csv' (22KB) to thread.

tara_security: Legal note: deletion cert requires tenant identifier and signed request. For Hosted we provide purge logs and audit trail; for Dedicated/Private we can provide a signed secure-wipe certificate.

sylvia_sales: Perfect. Next steps: Neil — technical appendix + measured numbers EOD. Tara — redacted SOC2 + deletion template EOD. Ben — updated CSV and explicit gates. I'll compile and send the RFI response tomorrow morning and pin the thread. :thumbsup:

neil_se: On it.

tara_security: On it.

upload-bot: Thread pinned in #sales by sylvia_sales for 48h
